description.zh:
是否返回私网访问的Kubeconfig，取值：

- `true`：返回私网访问的Kubeconfig

- `false`：返回公网访问的Kubeconfig
description.en:
Specifies whether to return a Kubeconfig for internal access. Valid values:

- `true`: Returns the Kubeconfig for internal access.

- `false`: Returns the Kubeconfig for Internet access.
The ID of the Service Mesh instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh revoke-kubeconfig --service-mesh-id cf08a11940e8c46c48bc791fcdb30000 --private-ip-address false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh RevokeKubeconfig --region cn-hangzhou --PrivateIpAddress false --ServiceMeshId cf08a11940e8c46c48bc791fcdb30000
